Intermediate.learningGoal: Build a keymap registry that records mappings, detects conflicts and applies them through a fake vim.keymap.set.
gotchas: Same lhs in the same mode overrides silently in Neovim, so detect conflicts yourself
mode can be a string or a list of modes
Buffer-local mappings are separate from global ones
goodSolutionShows: Registry stores intent, apply() calls the fake vim.keymap.set
Conflict detection reported, not thrown away
shapeHints: a keymap registry with conflict detection
applying mappings to a fake vim.keymap.set that records calls
grouping mappings by plugin with a description prefix

Advanced.learningGoal: Manage autocommand groups with idempotent setup and cleanup using a fake vim.api.
gotchas: Creating an augroup without clear = true duplicates autocommands on re-source
Callbacks run with event data tables; tests must supply them
goodSolutionShows: augroup created with clear semantics in the fake
A dispatcher that triggers fake events to run callbacks
Deletion of a registered autocommand via returned id
shapeHints: an autocommand registry with fire(event, args) on a fake vim.api
debouncing a BufWritePost handler with an injected timer function
